title: Warranty Coverage Missed-Visit Fee Basis for CareLine Service Plans Holders — Training Q&A
content:
**Basis.** For a missed technician visit under Warranty Coverage, the no-show fee is set by the owner's holding under the CareLine Service Plans:

1. For an owner who holds an **active CareLine plan whose waiting period had ended by the date of the missed visit**, the fee is **the lower of the CareLine plan's own no-show fee and the warranty plan's no-show fee**.
2. For an owner who holds an **active On-Call Service Account**, the fee is **the On-Call Service Account's no-show fee**.
3. For every other owner no fee basis applies under this rule.

A CareLine plan here is any plan of the CareLine Service Plans other than the On-Call Service Account.

## Questions answered

**Which plans are CareLine plans?** The CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year and Estate Plans, with active status on the CareLine Service Plans records. The On-Call Service Account is not one of them.

**When has the waiting period ended by the date of the missed visit?** When the missed visit is dated after the last day of the CareLine plan's waiting period, counted from its enrolled date as the CareLine Service Plans records show it.

**Which figure is charged to a CareLine plan holder past the waiting period?** Whichever is lower of the two: the CareLine plan's own no-show fee, or the warranty plan's no-show fee.

**What does an On-Call Service Account holder's fee rest on?** The no-show fee of the On-Call Service Account itself, whether that is higher or lower than the warranty plan's.

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

| Holding | Holding's own no-show fee | Warranty plan no-show fee | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| CareLine plan past its waiting period | 61.00 | 88.00 | 61.00 |
| CareLine plan past its waiting period | 104.00 | 88.00 | 88.00 |
| On-Call Service Account | 112.00 | 88.00 | 112.00 |
| CareLine plan, missed visit inside its waiting period | — | 88.00 | no fee basis under this rule |
